intake.customer_message: Thank you for contacting Harbourline. You've asked how many physiotherapy sessions per year your plan covers, given that your physiotherapist expects you'll need about eight sessions this year. A Harbourline support agent will review your request and follow up with you.

answer.customer_message: Thank you for your question. The handbook contains two rules that give different answers on physiotherapy session limits: one states physiotherapy is covered for up to 10 sessions per person per calendar year at 70% of the scheduled fee with no referral required (clause 6.1), while another states allied health services, including physiotherapy, are limited to a combined 6 sessions per person per calendar year at 60% of the scheduled fee (clause 9.3). Because these differ, a Harbourline agent will review and confirm which rule applies to your policy.
